decks.summary: Clue-drop Darrell who drops clues with Quick Study and Captivating Discovery for Research Notes and Press Pass, collects evidence to lower test difficulty, and recycles items with Scavenging; complex but fun.
Permanent Dark Horse Darrell with a two-Mariner's-Compass and Fine Tuning engine for up to six clues a turn, boosted by Mouse Mask, Death XIII and Madame Labranche.
Setup-light zero-difficulty Darrell: his evidence and Exploit Weakness bring tests to 0 for Shed a Light, and True Survivor and Scrounge for Supplies recycle the pieces.

Test-at-0 Darrell who makes every investigation difficulty 0 with Old Keyring (3), Gumption and his evidence, firing Shed a Light for three or more clues and recycling with Scavenging and True Survivor.
Beginner Darrell built beside a Mark Harrigan: he collects evidence with the Kodak, Empirical Hypothesis and Dissection Tools, spends it to lower tests for Shed a Light, and heals his partner.
Standalone Dark Horse Darrell with no cash and no cards: Empirical Hypothesis and Madame Labranche reward emptying his hand, Ice Pick (3) and Mariner's Compass take clues, and Scavenging recycles.
Will to Survive Darrell who replays it through True Survivor and Resourceful, passing tests by whatever margin Empirical Hypothesis and Scavenging want without looking at the bag; 30 XP.
Expert multiplayer Dark Horse Darrell with Mariner's Compasses, Hawk-Eye Folding Cameras and Research Notes, and Shed a Light for big clue turns; not for solo.
Research Notes Darrell who drops clues with Quick Study, Captivating Discovery and Bizarre Diagnosis to fuel his evidence, then picks them back up with Newspapers and Shed a Light.
Scarlet Keys to Drowned City Darrell who mixes 0-difficulty investigations with Old Keyring (3) and Shed a Light and exact successes with Steady-Handed and Alton O'Connell.
